28050.d: Troll Stronghold is a quest about gaining access to the Troll Stronghold beneath Mount Trollheim in order to rescue Godric, a soldier from Burthorpe.

28051.d: The Troll Stronghold is a stronghold inhabited by mountain trolls in the Troll Country.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• The Lunar spell Trollheim Farm Teleport to the roof of the Stronghold, then down the ladder into the stronghold itself
• The standard Trollheim Teleport spell to Trollheim. Run down the western side of the mountain, using Agility shortcuts (requires level 43 Agility) as needed, then go north up the ramp to the stronghold's main entrance.
• Run from Fremennik Province lodestone or AJR to the secret entrance (climbing boots and partial completion of the Troll Stronghold quest required)
• Run from Burthorpe to the southern entrance (climbing boots to climb the rocks and partial completion of the Troll Stronghold quest required)
• Run from Burthorpe lodestone to the main entrance (climbing boots required; this route is not recommended because it is long and players may be vulnerable to ranged attacks from thrower trolls, or are required level 47 Agility to go through the shortcuts.)

28056.d: Trollheim is one of the tallest mountains on Gielinor.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
All methods of travelling to Trollheim require partial completion of the quest Troll Stronghold after defeating the troll, Dad.
• Trollheim Teleport teleports the caster to the top of Trollheim, just outside of Eadgar's cave. Players must have at least Magic level 61, and completed Eadgar's Ruse quest to use this spell.
• From Burthorpe, travel north past the Death Plateau and through the arena (the area with Dad) and through the tunnel north of him.
• Travel to the fairy ring AJR (Fremennik Slayer Dungeon) and travel through the Troll Stronghold. This requires climbing boots.
• This route is used to reach the God Wars Dungeon. It is recommended to use the Protect from Ranged prayer near the level 68 thrower trolls, because they are aggressive to players less than combat level 137.
• A Trollheim tablet can be made after the Love Story quest by using a chisel on a Teleport to house tablet. However, it also requires the player to take a miner's diary from Runvastr in Keldagrim to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village.

28060.d: Trollweiss Mountain is the huge snowy mountain in the Troll Country.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
# Go up the north-western path north of Trollheim by one of these methods. Use Protect from Missiles if the Thrower trolls target you.
#* Go to Trollheim by teleporting there using the Trollheim Teleport and then climb the cliffside.
#* Walk there from Burthorpe via Troll Stronghold.
#* Walk there from Fremennik Province via Troll Stronghold. This requires climbing boots.
#* Use God Wars Dungeon Teleport and walk pass the boulder.
# When you reach the ice gate, go west instead of going through the gate. You will climb up to a cave entrance. While staying outside, the cold will affect your stats and run energy.
# Enter the tunnel and go to the other end. Beware of aggressive ice trolls. Protect from Melee is effective here.
# Exit the crevasse, and you're on top of Trollweiss Mountain.

28070.d: Trouble Brewing is a multiplayer minigame lasting 20 minutes that takes place on the east side of the pirate island of Mos Le'Harmless.

gt.heading: Getting There
gt.text:
Partial completion of Cabin Fever is required to access Mos Le'Harmless, and, by extension, Trouble Brewing. Most methods of reaching the minigame require running through the jungle, which contains numerous Jungle horrors. It is recommended to bring some food if you are a low combat level.
• Use a rum from the rewards shop.
• Use the Big Book o' Piracy to teleport to Mos Le'Harmless, then running north and east through the jungle
• Speak to Bill Teach on the docks of Port Phasmatys or the Pirate on the ship (cross gang-plank at eastern most point) to travel to the island. Run north into the jungle, then east to the lobby.
• Use the Charter ship to travel to the island. Then run north into the jungle, followed by east to the lobby.
• Fairy ring DIP to Mos Le'Harmless after completing A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift and repairing the bridges with 4 regular planks (protean planks do not work) and 8 nails per bridge (totalling 8 planks and 16 nails to fully complete the bridges). One bridge must be repaired from the island side, and one must be repaired from the fairy ring side. The bridges may break and must be repaired again. After teleporting to the Fairy ring, run north to the edge of the jungle, then east to the lobby.
• Pirate spell sheet teleport from Braindeath Island (easily accessed with the dungeoneering cape or hoardstalker ring teleport to the Braindeath Island 'Rum'-geon), and running north and east from the town.

28159.d: The Tunnel of Chaos can be found during and after the What Lies Below quest.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Fort Forinthry Teleport takes user relatively close to the Tunnel entrance. Alternatively, if built, the Fort Forinthry lodestone takes the user slightly closer.
• Using earth altar teleport to teleport to earth altar and travelling west.
• Balloon transport system to Varrock also takes user very close to the Tunnel entrance.
• Archaeology journal to Archaeology Guild and teleport to Infernal Source Dig Site (requires 20 Archaeology).
